hint.text:
Conditional 1
if-clause: if + simple present
main clause: will-future

Conditional 2
if-clause: if + simple past
main clause: would/could/might + infinitive

Conditional 3
if-clause: if + past perfect
main clause: would/could/might + have + past participle

instruction.text: Fill in the correct form, using the conditional clauses 1-3.

atoms.b: Making choices after school can feel overwhelming, especially when so much seems to depend on them. If students reflected more deeply on their values and strengths, they ((would_make 'd_make)) more meaningful decisions instead of simply following expectations.
In reality, many don’t take that time — and if they had done so, they ((might_have_avoided)) paths that didn’t suit them.
Still, the future is not set in stone: if you ((stay)) open-minded and curious, you will discover unexpected opportunities along the way.
Of course, if our education system ((was_focused)) more on personal development rather than just performance, young people would feel better prepared.
But even within the current system, if we ((take)) initiative and learn from each step, we will grow into our choices.

instruction.text: Read the quote. Which conditional clause best reflects its meaning?

atoms.a: Every year over 10000 US Americans die by firearms. Yet the seemingly obvious thing to do is not being done: gun laws are not being tightened and stricter regulation is not in sight. A frustrating situation for anti-gun activists who can do little to counter the influence of the powerful gun lobby NRA.
b: If gun laws are tightened, there will be fewer deaths by firearms.
++If gun laws were tightened, there would be fewer deaths by firearms.
If gun laws had been tightened, there would have been fewer deaths by firearms.

wrong.text: Type 2: Strengere Waffengesetze sind theoretisch möglich, durch den starken Einfluss der Waffenlobby aber unrealistisch.

atoms.a: Back in the late 1970s, internal studies by a major oil company predicted that the ever-increasing emission of greenhouse gases would cause climate change. However, the public was left in the dark about this. In retrospect, enormous time resources were wasted that could have been used to solve the problem.
b: Climate change will advance less if the public is not deceived.
Climate change would advance less if the public was not deceived.
++Climate change would have advanced less if the public had not been deceived.

wrong.text: Type 3: Die Bedingung liegt in der Vergangenheit und ist daher unmöglich zu realisieren.

atoms.a:
Liza: Why didn't you call her?
Jean: I already told you: I didn't feel like it.
Liza: But you promised.
Jean: When I promised, I assumed that I was already feeling better. But I wasn't.
Liza: Geez, girl.
b: Jean will call if she is feeling better.
Jean would call if she was feeling better.
++Jean would have called if she had been feeling better.

wrong.text: Type 3: Die Bedingung liegt in der Vergangenheit und ist daher unmöglich zu realisieren.

atoms.a: Miles has always dreamt of having a garden to relax outside and get away from the daily trouble. Unfortunately, he lives in the city and is unable to move because his job and family require him to stay. However, Miles has started to save some money every month, so he can invest in a shared garden compartment.
b: ++Miles will fulfil his dream of having a garden, if he saves enough money to invest.
Miles would fulfil his dream of having a garden, if he saved enough money to invest.
Miles would have fulfilled his dream of having a garden, if he had saved enough money to invest.

atoms.a: Talia and Tarek want to study at the same university after school. Since Tarek was able to get flawless marks, he decided to apply to one of the most prestigious universities in the country to make the best of his potential. He was already admitted by the registrar's office. Talia's marks are not as good as Tarek's, but she applied to this university anyway. Sadly, she has not heard back from them yet.
b: If the university admits Talia, their wish will be fulfilled.
++If the university admitted Talia, their wish would be fulfilled.
If the university had admitted Talia, their wish would have been fulfilled.

feedback.wrong: Type 2: Die Bedingung ist zwar noch realisierbar, aber unwahrscheinlich.
